source.text: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אוֹדְךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אָנַ֖פְתָּ בִּ֑י יָשֹׁ֥ב אַפְּךָ֖ וּֽתְנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will say in that day, I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, for you were angry with me; turned back your anger, and you comfort me.

en.L: And you will say in that day: \q I will give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} were angry with me; \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger has turned back, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} comfort me.
en.B: On that day you will say: \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! You were angry with me, \q but {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger has turned back, and now {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} comfort me.
en.R: At that time you will say: \q I thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! You were angry with me. \q But now {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger has gone away, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} comfort me.

es.L: Y dirás en aquel día: \q Te daré gracias, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} enojaste conmigo; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira se ha apartado, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me consuelas.
es.B: Aquel día dirás: \q ¡{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} doy gracias! Estabas enojado conmigo, \q pero {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira se ha apartado, y ahora {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me consuelas.
es.R: En ese tiempo dirás: \q ¡Te doy gracias, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Estabas enojado conmigo. \q Pero ahora {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enojo se ha ido, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me consuelas.

fr.L: Et tu diras en ce jour-là : \q Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rends grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} étais en colère contre moi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère s’est détournée, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consoles.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, tu diras : \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercie ! Tu étais en colère contre moi, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère s’est détournée, et maintenant {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consoles.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, tu diras : \q Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercie, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Tu étais en colère contre moi. \q Mais maintenant, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère est passée, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consoles.

sw.L: Nawe utasema katika siku ile: \q Nitakushukuru {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ulinikasirikia; \q hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} imegeuka, nawe unanifariji.
sw.B: Siku hiyo utasema: \q Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nakushukuru! Ulinikasirikia, \q lakini hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} imegeuka, na sasa unanifariji.
sw.R: Wakati huo utasema: \q Nakushukuru, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Ulinikasirikia. \q Lakini sasa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} imeondoka, nawe unanifariji.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy ngươi sẽ nói: \q Con sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giận con; \q cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nguôi, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} an ủi con.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy con sẽ nói: \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, con cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Ngài đã giận con, \q nhưng cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nguôi, và nay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} an ủi con.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy con sẽ nói: \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, con cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Ngài đã giận con. \q Nhưng nay cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã qua, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} an ủi con.

ko.L: 그리고 그날에 너는 말할 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 주님께 감사드립니다. 주님께서 저에게 노하셨으나, \q 주님의 분노가 돌이켜졌고, 주님께서 저를 위로하십니다.
ko.B: 그날에 너는 이렇게 말할 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께 감사드립니다! 주님께서 저에게 노하셨으나, \q 이제는 주님의 분노가 풀리고, 주님께서 저를 위로해 주십니다.
ko.R: 그때에 너는 이렇게 말할 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 감사합니다! 주님께서는 저에게 화가 나셨습니다. \q 그러나 이제는 주님의 화가 풀렸고, 주님께서 저를 위로해 주십니다.

pt.L: E dirás naquele dia: \q Eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darei graças, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} estavas irado comigo; \q a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira voltou atrás, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consolas.
pt.B: Naquele dia dirás: \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradeço! Tu estavas irado comigo, \q mas a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira recuou, e agora {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consolas.
pt.R: Naquele dia dirás: \q Eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradeço, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}! Tu estavas irado comigo. \q Mas agora a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira passou, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consolas.

decisions.choice: you will say: Israel addressed as one person
decisions.reason: "You" is singular here, the people addressed as one, as the song that follows speaks with one voice ("me", "my salvation"). From verse 3 the hearers are addressed in the plural. The chapter answers the "on that day" promises of chapter 11 with a song of thanks.

decisions.choice: your anger has turned back, and you comfort me
alternatives: may your anger turn back, and may you comfort me
decisions.reason: The verb forms are short forms that can express a wish ("may your anger turn back, and may you comfort me"). In a song of thanks they are better read as describing what God has done, and the Septuagint also reads them as past. The refrain of 5:25, 9:11 and 10:4, "his anger has not turned back", is here answered.

decisions.choice: I will give thanks: praise that thanks God by telling what he has done
decisions.reason: The verb means to acknowledge and praise, often by telling what God has done (Psalm 118:21, 28).

decisions.choice: "Ee BWANA" in direct address
decisions.reason: The vocative of the published Psalms (terms note); Literal keeps the bare name in the Hebrew order, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "tu diras"
decisions.reason: "You" is singular here, the people as one (meaning decision m1); from verse 3 the plural "vous" follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: Israel is "ngươi" (L) and "con" (B, R); in the song it says "con" to God, "lạy CHÚA" with no "O"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: Israel is addressed as one person, in a promise, so the terms note's "ngươi" / "con" applies; speaking to God in prayer, the singer calls itself "con" and God "Ngài", as the terms note sets for prayer.

decisions.choice: The song speaks to God in the formal style (합쇼체) with "저", and the vocative "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여"
decisions.reason: As the terms note for prayers and the Psalms (Psalm 19:15); verses 2-6 speak about God and to the people, and take the plain style.

decisions.choice: dirás (tu, Israel as one); te, tu, tua (the song to God)
decisions.reason: For the whole song: verse 1 speaks to Israel as one person (m1), so "dirás"; verses 3-4 turn to the plural, "vocês"; the song itself speaks to God with "tu" and the deity_pronoun setting, as the Psalms do. The LORD is called by name with the divine_name setting and no article, "SENHOR", as in the Psalms' Portuguese.

decisions.choice: a tua ira voltou atrás (L); a tua ira recuou (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one of the refrain of 5:25 and 9:11-10:4, "his anger has not turned back". Literal and Balanced use the same verb as their refrain ("não voltou atrás", "não recuou"), so that the song is heard as its answer.

source.text: הִנֵּ֨ה אֵ֧ל יְשׁוּעָתִ֛י אֶבְטַ֖ח וְלֹ֣א אֶפְחָ֑ד כִּֽי־עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ יָ֣הּ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיְהִי־לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, God [is] my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid, for my strength and [my] song [is] Yah, Yahweh, and he has become my salvation.

en.L: Look, God [is] my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid, \q for my strength and [my] song [is] Yah, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has become my salvation.
en.B: Look, God is my salvation! I will rely on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and not be afraid. \q For Yah, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, is my strength and my song; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has become my salvation.
en.R: God is the one who saves me! I will trust {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and not be afraid. \q Yah, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, makes me strong and gives me a song to sing. \q He has become the one who saves me.

es.L: He aquí, Dios [es] mi salvación; confiaré y no temeré, \q porque mi fuerza y [mi] canto [es] Yah, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha llegado a ser mi salvación.
es.B: ¡Dios es mi salvación! Me apoyaré en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y no tendré miedo. \q Porque Yah, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, es mi fuerza y el motivo de mi canto; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha llegado a ser mi salvación.
es.R: ¡Dios es el que me salva! Confiaré en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y no tendré miedo. \q Yah, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, me hace fuerte y me da un canto para cantar. \q Él ha llegado a ser el que me salva.

fr.L: Voici, Dieu [est] mon salut ; j’aurai confiance et je ne craindrai pas, \q car ma force et [mon] chant, [c’est] Yah, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est devenu pour moi le salut.
fr.B: Voici, Dieu est mon salut ! Je m’appuierai sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et je n’aurai pas peur. \q Car Yah, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, est ma force et mon chant ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est venu me sauver.
fr.R: Dieu est celui qui me sauve ! J’ai confiance en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et je n’ai pas peur. \q Yah, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, me rend fort et me donne un chant à chanter. \q Il m’a sauvé.

sw.L: Tazama, Mungu [ni] wokovu wangu; nitatumaini wala sitaogopa, \q kwa maana nguvu yangu na wimbo [wangu] [ni] Yah, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} amekuwa wokovu wangu.
sw.B: Tazama, Mungu ni wokovu wangu! Nitamtegemea wala sitaogopa. \q Kwa maana Yah, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ni nguvu yangu na wimbo wangu; \q amekuwa wokovu wangu.
sw.R: Mungu ndiye anayeniokoa! Nitamtumaini wala sitaogopa. \q Yah, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hunipa nguvu na kunipa wimbo wa kuimba. \q Amekuwa ndiye anayeniokoa.

vi.L: Kìa, Đức Chúa Trời [là] sự cứu rỗi của tôi; tôi sẽ tin cậy và không sợ hãi, \q vì sức mạnh và bài ca của tôi [là] Gia, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở nên sự cứu rỗi của tôi.
vi.B: Này, Đức Chúa Trời là sự cứu rỗi của tôi! Tôi sẽ nương cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và không sợ hãi. \q Vì Gia, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là sức mạnh và bài ca của tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở nên sự cứu rỗi của tôi.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng cứu tôi! Tôi sẽ tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và không sợ hãi. \q Gia, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ và cho tôi một bài ca để hát. \q Ngài đã trở thành Đấng cứu tôi.

ko.L: 보아라, 하나님은 나의 구원이시다. 내가 신뢰하고 두려워하지 않을 것이다. \q 나의 힘과 노래는 {{divine_name:주|야}}, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시니, \q 그분께서 나의 구원이 되셨다.
ko.B: 보아라, 하나님은 나의 구원이시다! 나는 그분을 의지하고 두려워하지 않겠다. \q {{divine_name:주|야}}, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나의 힘이시요 나의 노래이시니, \q 그분께서 나의 구원이 되셨다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 나를 구원하시는 분이시다! 나는 그분을 믿고 두려워하지 않겠다. \q {{divine_name:주|야}}, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 강하게 하시고 내게 부를 노래를 주신다. \q 그분께서 나를 구원하시는 분이 되셨다.

pt.L: Eis que Deus [é] a minha salvação; confiarei e não temerei, \q porque a minha força e [o meu] cântico [é] Iá, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se tornou a minha salvação.
pt.B: Vejam: Deus é a minha salvação! Vou me apoiar {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} e não terei medo. \q Pois a minha força e o meu cântico é Iá, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} veio para me salvar.
pt.R: Deus é quem me salva! Vou confiar {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} e não vou ter medo. \q Iá, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, me dá forças e é o motivo do meu canto. \q Ele me salvou.

decisions.choice: my strength and song is Yah ... he has become my salvation: the song of the sea
decisions.reason: These words repeat Exodus 15:2, the song Israel sang after crossing the sea, and they are sung again in Psalm 118:14. The second exodus of 11:11-16 is answered with the song of the first.

decisions.choice: Yah, Yahweh: the short form of the divine name, then the name in full
decisions.reason: Yah is a short form of the name Yahweh, used in Exodus 15:2 and in the cry "Hallelujah", "praise Yah". Isaiah adds the full name after it, as in 26:4, which makes the confession emphatic.

decisions.choice: song: the theme of my song
decisions.reason: The word normally means song or music, and "strength and song" makes God both the source of strength and the subject of praise. Because it stands beside "strength", it may instead mean "protection" or "might", as a word from a related root does elsewhere.

decisions.choice: Yah
decisions.reason: The short form is kept as "Yah" so that the reader can see the doubled name (m2); the full name that follows is written "the LORD" like every other occurrence.

decisions.choice: rely on him
decisions.reason: "Trust" has no object in the Hebrew; the object is God, named in the same line. Readable also says "trust him".

decisions.choice: Yah, el SEÑOR
decisions.reason: Isaiah doubles the name: the short form Yah, then the full name. As the English does, the short form is printed "Yah" so the reader sees both, and the full name is the usual divine_name span. The line echoes Exodus 15:2 and Psalm 118:14, whose published Spanish wording (mi fuerza y [mi] canto; ha llegado a ser mi salvación) is kept.

decisions.choice: "Yah, BWANA" with the short name kept
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the short name and then the full name (m2); the short name "Yah" stays as it is, as the English does, and the full name takes the usual span. The line echoes Exodus 15:2.

decisions.choice: "Yah, le SEIGNEUR"
decisions.reason: Isaiah doubles the name, so the short form "Yah" is kept in plain text before the full name, as the English does; the rest of the line keeps the wording of the published Exodus 15:2 and Psalm 118:14 ("Ma force et mon chant", "il est devenu pour moi le salut").

decisions.choice: "Gia" written plainly before "CHÚA"
alternatives: "CHÚA" with "Gia" as the alternative, as in Psalm 118:14
decisions.reason: Here the short form and the full name stand side by side (meaning decision m2); giving both as "CHÚA" would read "CHÚA, CHÚA", so the short form "Gia" is written out, as the English writes "Yah". The singer now speaks about God, not to him, and says "tôi", as in Psalm 118:14, which these words echo.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야}}, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" for "Yah, Yahweh"
decisions.reason: The Psalms note gives Yah as "{{divine_name:주|야}}". By default the two read "주, 곧 주", but with the setting they show the Hebrew's short form and full name side by side (meaning decision m2); the line follows the song of the sea and Psalm 118:14.

decisions.choice: Iá, o SENHOR; the words of Exodus 15:2
decisions.reason: These lines repeat the song of the sea (m1), and each level keeps the Portuguese of Exodus 15:2 and Psalm 118:14 ("A minha força e [o meu] cântico [é]", "se tornou a minha salvação" at Literal; "ele veio para me salvar" at Balanced; "me dá forças ... o motivo do meu canto. Ele me salvou" at Readable). Here the short name is followed by the full one (m2), so, as the English keeps "Yah", Portuguese writes the short name plainly as Exodus 15:2 spells it, "Iá", before "o SENHOR".

records.literal_gloss: And you will draw water with joy from [the] springs of salvation.

en.L: And you will draw water with joy \q from the springs of salvation.
en.B: Rejoicing, you will draw water \q from the springs of salvation.
en.R: You will be full of joy when God saves you. \q It will be like drawing fresh water from a spring.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sacarán|sacaréis}} agua con gozo \q de los manantiales de la salvación.
es.B: Con alegría {{plural_you:sacarán|sacaréis}} agua \q de los manantiales de la salvación.
es.R: {{plural_you:Estarán|Estaréis}} llenos de alegría cuando Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} salve. \q Será como sacar agua fresca de un manantial.

fr.L: Et vous puiserez de l’eau avec joie \q aux sources du salut.
fr.B: Dans la joie, vous puiserez de l’eau \q aux sources du salut.
fr.R: Vous serez remplis de joie quand Dieu vous sauvera. \q Ce sera comme puiser de l’eau fraîche à une source.

sw.L: Nanyi mtateka maji kwa furaha \q kutoka katika visima vya wokovu.
sw.B: Kwa shangwe mtateka maji \q kutoka katika chemchemi za wokovu.
sw.R: Mtajaa furaha Mungu atakapowaokoa. \q Itakuwa kama kuteka maji safi kutoka chemchemi.

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ vui mừng múc nước \q từ các nguồn cứu rỗi.
vi.B: Các ngươi sẽ hân hoan múc nước \q từ những nguồn suối cứu rỗi.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ tràn đầy niềm vui khi Đức Chúa Trời cứu các ngươi. \q Điều ấy sẽ như múc nước mát từ một dòng suối.

ko.L: 그리고 너희가 기쁨으로 \q 구원의 샘들에서 물을 길을 것이다.
ko.B: 너희가 기뻐하며 \q 구원의 샘에서 물을 길을 것이다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 너희를 구원하실 때 너희는 기쁨에 넘칠 것이다. \q 그것은 샘에서 시원한 물을 긷는 것과 같을 것이다.

pt.L: E vocês tirarão água com alegria \q das fontes da salvação.
pt.B: Com alegria vocês vão tirar água \q das fontes da salvação.
pt.R: Vocês vão ficar cheios de alegria quando Deus salvar vocês. \q Vai ser como tirar água fresca de uma fonte.

decisions.choice: drawing water from springs: God's saving help as life-giving water
decisions.reason: After the song of the sea Israel came to Elim, where there were twelve springs (Exodus 15:27), and God gave them water in the desert (Exodus 17:1-7). Isaiah uses water for God's gift of life again in 41:17-18, 44:3 and 55:1.

decisions.choice: you will draw: "you" plural
decisions.reason: The verb is plural. The hearers are now addressed together.

decisions.choice: when God saves you ... like drawing fresh water from a spring
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m1) and says who saves.

source.text: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֞ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָֽעַמִּ֖ים עֲלִֽילֹתָ֑יו הַזְכִּ֕ירוּ כִּ֥י נִשְׂגָּ֖ב שְׁמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will say in that day, give thanks to Yahweh, call on his name, make known among the peoples his deeds, bring to remembrance that exalted [is] his name.

en.L: And you will say in that day: \q Give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, call on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q make known among the peoples {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} deeds; \q bring [it] to mind that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name is exalted.
en.B: On that day you will say: \q Give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; call on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name! \q Make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} deeds known among the peoples; \q remind them that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name is lifted high.
en.R: At that time you will say: \q Thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Call out to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} by name! \q Tell the nations what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done. \q Remind them that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name is great and lifted high.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}} en aquel día: \q {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:invoquen|invocad}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q {{plural_you:den|dad}} a conocer entre los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hechos; \q {{plural_you:recuerden|recordad}} que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre es exaltado.
es.B: Aquel día {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}}: \q ¡{{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; {{plural_you:invoquen|invocad}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre! \q {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} a conocer {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hechos entre los pueblos; \q {{plural_you:recuérdenles|recordadles}} que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre está por encima de todo.
es.R: En ese tiempo {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}}: \q ¡{{plural_you:Denle|Dadle}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! ¡{{plural_you:Llámenlo|Llamadlo}} por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre! \q {{plural_you:Cuéntenles|Contadles}} a las naciones lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho. \q {{plural_you:Recuérdenles|Recordadles}} que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre es grande y está por encima de todo.

fr.L: Et vous direz en ce jour-là : \q Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, invoquez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q faites connaître parmi les peuples {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} hauts faits ; \q rappelez que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom est élevé.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, vous direz : \q Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; invoquez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ! \q Faites connaître {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} actions parmi les peuples ; \q rappelez-leur que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom est élevé bien haut.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, vous direz : \q Remerciez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Appelez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ! \q Dites aux nations ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait. \q Rappelez-leur que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom est grand et élevé bien haut.

sw.L: Nanyi mtasema katika siku ile: \q Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, liitieni jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q julisheni kati ya mataifa matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q kumbusheni kwamba jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} limetukuka.
sw.B: Siku hiyo mtasema: \q Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; liitieni jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}! \q Yajulisheni mataifa matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q wakumbusheni kwamba jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} limeinuliwa juu.
sw.R: Wakati huo mtasema: \q Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Mwiteni kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}! \q Waambieni mataifa yale aliyoyatenda. \q Wakumbusheni kwamba jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni kuu na limeinuliwa juu.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy các ngươi sẽ nói: \q Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy làm cho các dân biết những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm; \q hãy nhắc rằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn cao.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy các ngươi sẽ nói: \q Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; hãy kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Hãy rao truyền công việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữa các dân; \q hãy nhắc cho họ nhớ rằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn cao.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy các ngươi sẽ nói: \q Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Hãy kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Hãy kể cho các dân tộc biết những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm. \q Hãy nhắc cho họ nhớ rằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật vĩ đại và được tôn cao.

ko.L: 그리고 그날에 너희가 말할 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. 그분의 이름을 불러라. \q 백성들 가운데 그분께서 하신 일들을 알려라. \q 그분의 이름이 높으심을 기억하게 하여라.
ko.B: 그날에 너희는 이렇게 말할 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하고 그분의 이름을 불러라! \q 그분께서 하신 일을 모든 백성에게 알려라. \q 그분의 이름이 높으시다는 것을 일깨워 주어라.
ko.R: 그때에 너희는 이렇게 말할 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라! 그분의 이름을 부르며 기도하여라! \q 그분께서 하신 일을 온 세상 사람들에게 알려라. \q 그분의 이름이 위대하고 높으시다는 것을 그들에게 일깨워 주어라.

pt.L: E vocês dirão naquele dia: \q Rendam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, invoquem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome; \q façam conhecidos entre os povos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} feitos; \q lembrem que o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome é exaltado.
pt.B: Naquele dia vocês dirão: \q Rendam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}; invoquem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome! \q Contem a todos os povos o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez; \q lembrem a eles que o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome está acima de tudo.
pt.R: Naquele dia vocês dirão: \q Agradeçam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}! Chamem por {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pelo nome! \q Contem às nações o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez. \q Lembrem a elas que o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome é grande e está acima de tudo.

decisions.choice: give thanks ... call on his name ... make known his deeds: a familiar call to praise
decisions.reason: The first three lines match Psalm 105:1 (and 1 Chronicles 16:8), where Israel is called to tell the nations what God has done.

decisions.choice: call on his name: call to him in worship, and proclaim who he is
decisions.reason: To call on the name of the LORD is to pray and worship (Genesis 12:8; Psalm 116:17). Here, beside "make known among the peoples", it includes declaring his name aloud. His name stands for the LORD himself, as he has made himself known.

decisions.choice: bring to remembrance: declare, call to mind
decisions.reason: The verb means to cause to remember, so to declare or proclaim. "Exalted" means set high, beyond reach (2:11, 17; 33:5).

decisions.choice: "Rendez grâce au SEIGNEUR, invoquez son nom ; faites connaître parmi les peuples ses hauts faits"
decisions.reason: The first lines are the same Hebrew as Psalm 105:1, whose published French Literal wording is reused.

decisions.choice: The wording of Psalm 105:1 ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. 그분의 이름을 불러라...")
alternatives: | The same call to praise in the same Hebrew words (meaning decision m1), so the published Korean wording is reused.

decisions.choice: Rendam graças ao SENHOR; invoquem o seu nome; façam conhecidos entre os povos os seus feitos (L); contem a todos os povos o que ele fez (B)
decisions.reason: The first three lines match Psalm 105:1 and 1 Chronicles 16:8 (m1), and keep the Portuguese of Psalm 105:1 at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: זַמְּר֣וּ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י גֵא֖וּת עָשָׂ֑ה מוּדַ֥עַת זֹ֖את בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing praise to Yahweh, for majesty he has done; [is being] made known this in all the earth.

en.L: Sing praise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done majestic [things]; \q [let] this [be] made known in all the earth.
en.B: Make music to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has acted in majesty; \q let the whole earth come to know it.
en.R: Sing praises to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! He has done great and wonderful things. \q Let everyone in the world know about it.

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} alabanzas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho [cosas] majestuosas; \q [que] esto [sea] conocido en toda la tierra.
es.B: {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} música para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha actuado con majestad; \q que toda la tierra llegue a saberlo.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} alabanzas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! Él ha hecho cosas grandes y maravillosas. \q Que todo el mundo lo sepa.

fr.L: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait des [choses] magnifiques ; \q [que] cela [soit] connu par toute la terre.
fr.B: Jouez pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a agi avec majesté ; \q que toute la terre le sache.
fr.R: Chantez des louanges {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! Il a fait des choses grandes et merveilleuses. \q Que tout le monde le sache !

sw.L: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sifa, kwa maana ametenda [mambo] makuu; \q [na] hili [lijulikane] katika dunia yote.
sw.B: Mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} muziki, kwa maana ametenda kwa utukufu; \q dunia yote na ilijue jambo hili.
sw.R: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sifa! Ametenda mambo makuu na ya ajabu. \q Kila mtu ulimwenguni na ajue habari hii.

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm những [việc] oai nghiêm; \q [hãy để] điều này được biết khắp đất.
vi.B: Hãy tấu nhạc ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hành động cách oai nghiêm; \q hãy để cả trái đất biết điều ấy.
vi.R: Hãy hát ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Ngài đã làm những việc lớn lao kỳ diệu. \q Hãy để mọi người trên thế giới biết điều ấy.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 찬양하여라. 그분께서 위엄 있는 [일들을] 하셨다. \q 이것을 온 땅에 알려라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하며 찬양하여라. 그분께서 위엄 있게 일하셨다. \q 온 땅이 이것을 알게 하여라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 찬양의 노래를 불러라! 그분께서 크고 놀라운 일을 하셨다. \q 온 세상 사람들이 그것을 알게 하여라.

pt.L: Cantem louvores {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez [coisas] majestosas; \q [seja] isto conhecido em toda a terra.
pt.B: Toquem e cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} agiu com majestade; \q que a terra inteira fique sabendo disso.
pt.R: Cantem louvores {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}! Ele fez coisas grandes e maravilhosas. \q Que todas as pessoas do mundo fiquem sabendo disso.

decisions.choice: he has done majestically: the language of the song of the sea
decisions.reason: The noun is from the root used in Exodus 15:1 and 15:21, "he has triumphed gloriously", literally "he is highly exalted". Isaiah's song again echoes the song of the first exodus.

decisions.choice: made known: the scribes' reading
alternatives: this is made known in all the earth
decisions.reason: The written text and the reading the scribes marked for reading aloud have two forms of the same passive verb. Both mean "made known"; the translation follows the reading aloud. As a participle, the verb could also state a fact ("this is made known"); after the commands to sing it is taken as a wish.

decisions.choice: sing praise: make music in praise
decisions.reason: The verb is used of singing praise, often with instruments (Psalm 33:2; 98:5).

source.text: צַהֲלִ֥י וָרֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־גָד֥וֹל בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Cry out and shout for joy, inhabitant of Zion, for great in your midst [is the] Holy One of Israel.

en.L: Cry out and shout for joy, inhabitant of Zion, \q for great in your midst [is] the Holy One of Israel.
en.B: Raise the cry and sing out, you who live in Zion, \q for the Holy One of Israel, who is among you, is great.
en.R: People of Zion, shout and sing for joy! \q The Holy One of Israel is with you, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is great.

es.L: Grita y canta de júbilo, habitante de Sion, \q porque grande [es] en medio de ti el Santo de Israel.
es.B: Levanta la voz y canta, tú que habitas en Sion, \q porque el Santo de Israel, que está en medio de ti, es grande.
es.R: ¡Pueblo de Sion, grita y canta de alegría! \q El Santo de Israel está contigo, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es grande.

fr.L: Pousse des cris et chante de joie, habitante de Sion, \q car grand au milieu de toi [est] le Saint d’Israël.
fr.B: Crie et chante de joie, toi qui habites Sion, \q car le Saint d’Israël, qui est au milieu de toi, est grand.
fr.R: Habitants de Sion, criez et chantez de joie ! \q Le Saint d’Israël est avec vous, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est grand.

sw.L: Piga kelele na kushangilia, ewe mkaaji wa Sayuni, \q kwa maana mkuu katikati yako [ni] Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Paza sauti na uimbe, ewe ukaaye Sayuni, \q kwa maana Mtakatifu wa Israeli, aliye katikati yako, ni mkuu.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Sayuni, pigeni kelele na kuimba kwa furaha! \q Mtakatifu wa Israeli yuko pamoja nanyi, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ni mkuu.

vi.L: Hỡi cư dân Si-ôn, hãy reo hò và hát mừng, \q vì Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên ở giữa ngươi thật vĩ đại.
vi.B: Hỡi dân cư Si-ôn, hãy cất tiếng reo vui, \q vì Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng ở giữa con, thật vĩ đại.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Si-ôn, hãy reo hò và hát mừng! \q Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên ở cùng con, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật vĩ đại.

ko.L: 시온의 주민아, 소리치고 기뻐 외쳐라. \q 이스라엘의 거룩하신 분이 너희 가운데 크시기 때문이다.
ko.B: 시온에 사는 사람들아, 소리 높여 기뻐 노래하여라. \q 너희 가운데 계시는 이스라엘의 거룩하신 분은 위대하시다.
ko.R: 시온 백성아, 기뻐 소리치며 노래하여라! \q 이스라엘의 거룩하신 분께서 너희와 함께 계신다. 그분은 위대하시다.

pt.L: Grita e canta de alegria, moradora de Sião, \q porque grande no meio de ti [é] o Santo de Israel.
pt.B: Levanta a voz e canta com alegria, tu que moras em Sião, \q pois o Santo de Israel, que está no meio de ti, é grande.
pt.R: Povo de Sião, grita e canta de alegria! \q O Santo de Israel está contigo, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é grande.

decisions.choice: inhabitant of Zion: the people of Zion pictured as one woman
decisions.reason: The word is a feminine singular, "she who lives in Zion", the city's people pictured as a woman, like "Daughter Zion" (1:8; 10:32).

decisions.choice: the Holy One of Israel in your midst
decisions.reason: "The Holy One of Israel" is Isaiah's own title for God (1:4; 5:19; 10:20), which recalls the vision of his holiness in 6:3. The God whose holiness once threatened his sinful people now lives among them as their joy.

decisions.choice: People of Zion
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who is addressed (m1).

decisions.choice: singular (grita, canta; habitante de Sion)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is a feminine singular, the people of Zion pictured as one woman (meaning decision m1), so Spanish keeps the singular "tú" even where R says "pueblo de Sion"; no plural_you span is needed.

decisions.choice: "habitante de Sion"
decisions.reason: The word is feminine singular, the city’s people pictured as a woman (meaning decision m1); Literal keeps it, Readable addresses the people.

decisions.choice: moradora de Sião (L); tu que moras em Sião (B); Povo de Sião (R)
decisions.reason: The word is feminine singular, the people of Zion pictured as one woman (m1). Literal keeps the feminine with "moradora" and the "tu" of 1:22; Balanced says "tu que moras", and Readable "Povo de Sião", as the English Readable does.
